//: Vercel auto-detects TanStack Start and Nitro, so no build command or output
directory is needed - the nitro() plugin in vite.config.ts is what makes
that work. The framework is pinned anyway because this site lives in a
website/ subdirectory, which is the case Vercel's own docs call out as one
The Vercel project's Root Directory must be set to 'website'. That is a
dashboard setting and cannot be committed, so it is recorded here.
There are no environment variables. The site has no analytics, no server
secrets and no API calls, which is the point of it.
The download routes are 307 redirects, so a crawler never receives a
document and never sees a noindex meta tag - the header is the only way
to say it. Without this, /download can be indexed as a page, and a
search result that fires a 234 MB download instead of showing a page is
a bad outcome for the visitor and for the site.
